Hi, I’m
Dr. Rachel.

Orthodontics is personal.
And that’s just how I like it.

Every smile has a person behind it. Dr. Rachel Hoffman brings board-certified expertise and a warm, down-to-earth approach to helping you feel informed, comfortable, and cared for.

A Midwesterner by birth and a Southerner at heart, she’s proud to call Memphis home. Outside the office, you’ll find her trying new recipes, collecting vinyl records, or taking a walk with her husband, Terry.

More frequently asked questions
Do I need a referral?

No referral needed. You’re welcome to contact our team directly to schedule a complimentary consultation with Dr. Hoffman.

Is orthodontic care just for kids?

Not at all. We offer braces and clear aligners for children, teenagers, and adults. Your consultation is a chance to explore the right options for your smile.

What about payments and insurance?

We accept most insurance providers and offer flexible payment plans. Our team will help you understand your benefits and create a plan that fits your budget.
